model_detail.name: A — shrinkage ratio (bake-off winner)
model_detail.method: per 0.25 deg cell x calendar month x day/night: posterior MODIS per VIIRS detection (a + sum MODIS) / (a / r0 + sum VIIRS), r0 = the region's ratio for that month and time of day; b_A = mean MODIS where VIIRS saw nothing (pipeline/bakeoff/models.py fit_A, predict_A)
model_detail.interval: A's predictive per cell-month (negative binomial for V > 0, Poisson(b_A) for V = 0), day + night added, two satellites averaged with variances combined; 10th/90th percentile of the moment-matched negative binomial (approximate)

combination.rule: in each region x calendar month x day/night slot, a satellite enters the average only if model A's prior ratio r0 > 0 there; one qualifying satellite carries the slot alone; none qualifying keeps A's literal behaviour (weight 0, background as fitted). Decided 31 Oct 2026 after observing NOAA-20's short 21-month fit window. Model A itself is unchanged.
